name: Doukyuusei 2
source:
As graduation looms on the horizon during the final winter break of his college life, Ryuunosuke finds himself immersed in creating precious memories with a special girl, even as the uncertainty of his future path weighs on his mind. It's as if, losing himself in these moments, he can glimpse what lies ahead... This story is brimming with the bittersweet essence of youth - pure desire intertwined with listless passion. As if shrouded in a feverish haze, the dreamlike days are drawing to a close...

Ryuunosuke spends his time grappling with indecision, trying to figure out what he wants, should do, and is capable of doing. Despite the confusion, the inevitable "end" that signifies a new chapter is fast approaching. Who will he choose to walk beside in the days to come? Where will his path lead? The only way to discover is to enter the city and embrace the world! The "answer" he seeks must be out there, waiting to be discovered...

[Translated and edited from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/elf_0029//]DMM.com[/url]]
